title: Single-nucleus RNA sequencing highlights endothelial and Muller cell ER stress in VLDLR-/- mouse retina
Vldlr_KO_P46
data_processing: Raw sequencing data were processed using CellRanger v7.2.0 to generate gene-barcode matrics.

Quality control was performed in Seurat v3.0.2. Nuclei with <200 detected genes, extremely high gene counts (>90th percentile), or high mitochondrial RNA content (top 15%) were removed, and doublets were excluded using DoubletDetection.
Assembly: Raw reads were processed with CellRanger v7.2.0 and aligned to the mm10-2020-A reference genome to generate geneâbarcode matrices.
Supplementary files format and content: barcodes.tsv.gz files contain cell-associated barcodes filtered by CellRanger labeling the columns of the count matrix for each respective sample.
Supplementary files format and content: features.tsv.gz files contain genes/peaks/features labeling the rows of the count matrix for each respective sample.
Supplementary files format and content: matrix.mtx.gz files contain the sequencing counts data to be aligned with the barcodes and features files for each respective sample.
